faq.q: Can one garment photo make a clip and a listing image?
faq.a: Yes. Make a vertical try-on clip and an on-model still from the garment photo. Review the fit and color before posting.

faq.q: Can a flat-lay photo show the clothing on a person?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear full-length garment photo or its product link, then choose an AI avatar and scene.

faq.q: Will the print or fabric details stay accurate?
faq.a: The result follows your source photo. Check stripes, seams, buttons, and color against the garment before you use it.

faq.q: Can I choose the build of the AI avatar?
faq.a: Yes. Describe the height, build, and age range you need, then review the silhouette before you download.

faq.q: What garment photo should I upload?
faq.a: Lay the piece flat or hang it in even light. Keep the full outline, print, and fastenings in frame.

faq.q: How do I keep the clothing color accurate?
faq.a: Photograph the garment in soft daylight and compare the finished ad with the real sample.

faq.q: Can I run these clips as paid clothing ads?
faq.a: Yes. You can use the watermark-free download in paid ads. Check every fabric and size claim against what you ship.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a creator?
faq.a: You pay the credits shown before generation instead of booking a creator. Review the garment details before posting the ad.

faq.q: Can a clothing try-on include a voice and captions?
faq.a: Yes. The clip can include a spoken line and captions, and you can publish it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
